objective: Compare frozen023 metadata_v1 against additive test-duration normalization, repeating base/020/022 under identical ceilings; no training, model selection or final tests.

reference020.role: frozen development comparator, not an eligible release candidate

schedule: Latin rotation of model order across three repeats; fresh backend per model/repeat. Pair baseline/extended adjacently for every task, alternate first condition by task index + repeat + model index. Same original task order. No score-dependent scheduling.

normalization.baseline: Exact023 metadata_v1 applied to historical raw2400-character prefix; verified byte-for-byte on every023 observation before freeze.
normalization.extended: Apply metadata_v1 then remove only complete recognized pytest/unittest aggregate durations and optional AVA reporter row-end durations, preserving test identity, status, count, order and every other character.
normalization.untouched: No source changes, command rewrites, filename rewriting, arbitrary log dates, exception messages, ordering changes or independent-grader changes. Pattern-only recognition can match same-shaped text; retained private raw/delivered journals permit audit.
normalization.cap: Same historical raw prefix, then metadata_v1 cap, then v2 removal; never expose hidden tail. Complete trailing lines only; preserve an incomplete last line when original output is truncated.

probes.input: Exact initial request from recorded022 development history; encoded hashes checked before freeze. No command execution.
probes.role: Within-load and across-load identical-input checks, excluded from task budgets/scores; fixed before all task runs.

analysis.primary: For each model/condition: action-sequence disagreements /45 task-repeat pairs and mixed-action tasks /15; pass/fail disagreements /45 and mixed-outcome tasks /15; report repeat score range. Command identity and model-call positions jointly define action sequences. No model selection.
analysis.secondary: Exact input/output hashes,135 matched baseline/extended pairs, first-divergence boundaries, first edit, no-edit failures, actual time/tokens, normalization coverage and hardware. Six fixed-input probe groups with6calls each; task identical-input grouping preregistered.
analysis.attribution: At first trace divergence: identical input but different generated output is observed generation variability; identical preceding actions/state but different feedback is observed tool variability, subdivided by whether allowed metadata normalization makes feedback identical. Later consequences not assigned a unique cause. Different grades with identical trajectories separately flagged.
analysis.paired_effect: Descriptive changes of the complete v2 output intervention relative to metadata_v1 on15 reused tasks. No isolated causal attribution per field or broad quality claim.
analysis.incomplete: Retain every attempt; exclude incomplete pairs from rates with explicit denominators. Do not rerun completed tasks or choose favorable repeats. Deadline is not extended.
analysis.statistics: Descriptive counts and exact denominators only; three repeats and reused task clusters are too small for broad statistical or causal claims.

failure_policy: One16-hour clock includes all model loads,36fixed probes,270task runs and loaded controls. Resume only completed-step checkpoints within original deadline. Keep failed attempts; no duplicate scores, extra probes, relaxed budgets or extension.
limitations: Three repeats on15 reused development tasks across four repositories; no new holdout score or release decision.

metadata_v2 only changes complete recognized duration rows. Other timestamps, addresses, output order and unmatched noise remain untouched. Same-shaped source text can match; all transformations are independently audited.
Existing greedy/SDPA/seed101 settings retained, deterministic CUDA switches not changed. Equal ceilings do not mean equal actual tokens,FLOPs or runtime.
